meta.name: AI翻译工坊
meta.workflow_dsl:
version: "2.0"
description: "AI 翻译工坊 - 智能中英文互译"

nodes:
  - id: input
    type: input
    description: "接收用户输入的文本"
    
  - id: detect_language
    type: function
    description: "检测输入文本的语言（中文或英文）"
    code: |
      function detectLanguage(input) {
        const chineseRegex = /[\u4e00-\u9fa5]/;
        if (chineseRegex.test(input)) {
          return "chinese";
        }
        return "english";
      }
    
  - id: translate_to_english
    type: llm
    model: 1
    system_prompt: "你是专业的翻译助手，请将中文翻译成英文。只返回翻译结果，不要添加任何解释。"
    description: "中译英"
    
  - id: translate_to_chinese
    type: llm
    model: 1
    system_prompt: "你是专业的翻译助手，请将英文翻译成中文。只返回翻译结果，不要添加任何解释。"
    description: "英译中"
    
  - id: output
    type: output
    description: "输出翻译结果"

edges:
  - from: input
    to: detect_language
    
  - from: detect_language
    to: translate_to_english
    condition: "chinese"
    
  - from: detect_language
    to: translate_to_chinese
    condition: "english"
    
  - from: translate_to_english
    to: output
    
  - from: translate_to_chinese
    to: output
